match: Post-surgical recovery, neurological disorders, and musculoskeletal injuries are some of the conditions for which physical therapy rehabilitation is a cornerstone of recovery. The effectiveness of such rehabilitation programs is dependent on patient adherence to prescribed exercise regimens, especially home exercise programs. However, many studies have reported persistently low patient adherence to home exercise programs, with recent evidence indicating that only about 43% of patients fully adhere to prescribed physical therapy programs (Shahidi et al., 2022). Some of the frequently cited barriers to adherence to home exercise programs include lack of supervision, absence of in-the-moment corrective feedback, and repeating exercise content and processes. Without appropriate guidance, patients can perform exercises incorrectly, which might lead to reinjury or delay recovery.
